title: You asked an assistant to check your statement. Whose instructions did the bank receive?
description: Wells Fargo’s new agreement spells out how it will treat instructions from AI assistants. OpenAI’s chief scientist proposes tracking pretraining progress with perplexity, and OpenRouter changes which endpoints qualify for zero data retention.

wells-agent-authority.verification_scope: WIRED reporting and section 15 of the Wells Fargo online agreement effective November 24.

perplexity-pretraining.verification_scope: The author’s article and footnotes, including the fixed code sample and limits on comparisons across labs.

openrouter-retention.verification_scope: OpenRouter’s November 22 notice distinguishes providers, endpoint eligibility and incidents.

hyperscale-communities.verification_scope: The interview distinguishes Paris Marx’s observations during his visit from his assessment.

esg-intention.verification_scope: Publisher record and authors’ abstract via OpenAlex. The review covered the abstract, not the full paper.

ronacher-workshop.verification_scope: Publisher description and chapter list, with the public Concourse entry. No direct quotations.

muru-lazy-imports.verification_scope: Author’s engineering note and project repository. The example and benchmarks were not run.
